Subject: Novum — conditional MFN + limited exclusivity request (need exec review)

Hi team,

Quick summary: Novum Health (large prospect, piloting Q3) is asking for two commercial items that push our guardrails:
- MFN for price/perf against direct competitors for 18 months (applies to embedding and hosted API pricing tiers)
- A targeted exclusivity window across a specific product vertical ("CareCoord") in two EHR-integrated markets for 12 months, with a carve-out for edge cases

They've committed to a 9-month pilot (expected ARR $420k if converted) and are asking for a one-time onboarding credit that would reduce first-quarter billings by ~35%. They want the MFN + exclusivity in the SOW; legal attached their redline.

Why I'm escalating: MFN + exclusivity together are high commercial risk — MFN increases pricing exposure; exclusivity limits go-to-market for us in a couple regional accounts. Deal desk has already pushed this back; we need executive approval for:
1) Whether we can offer a time-limited MFN and, if yes, what floors/guardrails (e.g., comparator set, bucketed baselines).
2) Whether we can accept territory/vertical-limited exclusivity and on what compensation/guardrails.
3) Final signoff on the onboarding credit and whether to convert it to a capped rebate tied to usage metrics.

Attachments: Novum_SOW_v3.pdf, Proposed_MFN_clause_redline.docx

Next steps I propose: Jonas to summarize recommended guardrails; Legal (Rishi) to confirm acceptable redline changes; Marissa to approve commercial exception (if any).

Requesting a decision today EOD — they are pushing for contracting next week.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Novum — conditional MFN + limited exclusivity request (need exec review)

Marissa / Ben —

Short read for execs: I reviewed Novum's ask and their redline. Key points and recommendations below.

Commercial asks from customer:
- MFN: 18 months, applies to hosted API and embeddings. No explicit comparator list in their draft; they used language "any materially similar pricing offered to a competitor."
- Exclusivity: 12 months, limited to "CareCoord" workflows for customers integrated with EHRs in the states of OR and WA. They propose a penalty if we pre-sell CareCoord to other customers in those states.
- Onboarding credit: $35k credit (approx 35% of Q1 projected billings) up-front.

Risk analysis (short):
- MFN opens us to downstream price anchoring; without a narrow comparator set and explicit carve-outs (e.g., pilots, channel partners, limited feature sets), this is open-ended.
- Territorial exclusivity materially constrains selling motion in two states for a small window but sets a precedent for vertical carve-outs.
- Combined MFN + exclusivity increases valuation risk: if we discount deeply for Novum, MFN could force us to extend similar economics to other large buyers.

Recommended guardrails (what Deal Desk recommends):
1) Convert MFN to a "pricing parity for like-for-like published tiers" for 12 months (not 18), limited to published per-unit pricing and excluding credits/rebates/one-off promotions. Comparator set: published list prices and published onboarding discounts (exclude negotiated enterprise-only promos).
2) Exclusivity: Allow a targeted exclusivity for CareCoord but limited to: (a) active pilot customer list (Novum only) and (b) apply only to full-production commercial agreements (not pilots), and (c) include a revenue share / supplemental commitment: if exclusivity is requested, require minimum committed ARR threshold (we propose $600k ARR over 12 months) or a fixed exclusivity fee.
3) Replace up-front onboarding credit with a usage-tied rebate that vests over 3 months and is capped at $25k.

Legal asks (Rishi): narrow MFN language with explicit exclusions (pilots, channel, promotional windows) and a defined comparator scope. Add sunset clause and reporting cadence.

Decision asked from Marissa: Approve the above guardrails or provide counter guidance. If approved, instruct Sales to present the adjusted terms; Legal will re-draft the redline.

If you want a one-line executive summary: Approve limited 12-month MFN restricted to published tiers + conditional 12-month targeted exclusivity tied to a minimum committed ARR or exclusivity fee; swap credit for capped, usage-tied rebate.

Jonas
Head of Deal Desk

Thanks Jonas — good summary. I spoke with Finance briefly and reviewed the pilot economics. I'm comfortable with a constrained exception on the following lines: 

1) MFN: Approve 12 months only, explicitly limited to published list prices for hosted API/embeddings and excluding promotional discounts, partner/channel offers, and any customer-specific rebates. The wording must include an explicit comparator definition and an audit/reporting right for us.

2) Exclusivity: Approve a 12-month exclusivity limited to CareCoord workflows but only if Novum either (a) commits to $600k ARR within 12 months OR (b) pays a non-refundable exclusivity fee of $90k. Exclusivity must have a narrow geography clause (OR + WA only) and an explicit carve-out for pilots and academic customers.

3) Onboarding credit: Convert to a usage-vested rebate capped at $25k, paid over 3 bill cycles and contingent on usage thresholds.

4) Escalation guardrails: This exception is conditional on Legal's final redline and a revenue recognition plan from Finance. If Legal flags material open-ended exposure, I will rescind approval.

If Legal is comfortable, Jonas — please have Ben present these adjustments to Novum today and push for DocuSign next week. Rishi — please produce a tight redline that implements the comparator set + carve-outs.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
